Independent. Founder-led. Solution-oriented.

Every problem is different.
Every solution should be too.

Some problems are straightforward. Others involve several moving parts, competing interests, unfamiliar territory or no obvious way forward.

Fresh perspective. Practical experience. The right people around the table.

Not every problem has a ready-made answer.

There are situations where a standard consultant’s report is not enough. A business may need to rethink its model. A project may be stuck between different stakeholders. A property opportunity may involve complicated commercial or institutional considerations. A creative idea may need a viable production plan.

Sometimes the challenge is not a lack of ideas. It is knowing which direction to take, who needs to be involved and how to turn a possibility into something workable. That is where Jugaad Advisory comes in.

How we think

Understand first. Solve second.

We do not begin with a predetermined package. We begin by understanding the situation: what is the actual problem, what has been tried, what is preventing progress, and what would a workable outcome look like?

The solution must fit the problem — not the other way around.

One practice. Different perspectives.

Jugaad Advisory draws on experience across business, advertising, films, media, production, property, agriculture, rural development and environmental initiatives. Some assignments require one perspective. Others need several.

We work on a founder-led basis and bring in relevant specialists, professionals or associates when the assignment requires them. We do not believe in having an answer for everything. We believe in finding the right way to address each problem.

Why Jugaad
